```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
```

```{r}
analysis_data <- read.csv("data/processed/analysis_data.csv")
```

```{r}
# Compute summary metrics for key continuous and indicator variables
vars_to_summarize <- c("positive_pct", "base_price_usd", "total_reviews", "log_reviews",
"is_free", "monetization_none", "cosmetic_only", "gameplay_advantage", "paywalled_content")
```

```{r}
summary_table <- analysis_data |>
 select(all_of(vars_to_summarize)) |>
 pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "Variable", values_to =
"Value") |>
 group_by(Variable) |>
 summarise(
 Mean = round(mean(Value, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
 SD = round(sd(Value, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
 Median = round(median(Value, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
 Min = round(min(Value, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
 Max = round(max(Value, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
 .groups = "drop"
 )
print(as.data.frame(summary_table))
```
